Вершина з руїнами обсерваторії «Білий сл: A summit crowned by the ruins of the “White Elephant” observatory. A long climb from Dzembronia, a night in a tent below the ridge and sunrise above the clouds.
Класичний перехід головним хребтом: Петр: The classic crossing of the main ridge: Petros, Hoverla, Turkul, Pip Ivan. Three days above the treeline, with nights by lakes Nesamovyte and Brebeneskul.
Two neighbouring Gorgany peaks in one day. Forest, scree fields and a wide view of Chornohora. A great first route for a weekend.
Найвища вершина Горган. Довгий підхід лі: The highest peak of Gorgany. A long approach along a forest road, a night by a spring and a climb over scree to Syvulia's twin summits.
Льодовикове озеро під Близницею. Від Дра: A glacial lake below Blyznytsia. From Drahobrat the trail crosses the meadows to the summit of Blyznytsia, then drops down to a quiet cirque lake.
Найвища вершина Боржави. Довгий, але рів: The highest peak of Borzhava. A long but steady climb across grassy meadows. In late summer the trail is lined with bilberries.
Найвища точка Сколівських Бескидів. Лісо: The highest point of the Skole Beskydy. A forest trail, rock outcrops on the summit and a panorama of the Opir valley.
«Морське око» Карпат. Коротка прогулянка: The “Sea Eye” of the Carpathians. A short walk around Ukraine's largest mountain lake — good for families with children.
